name: io.github.OpenAdaptAI/openadapt-agent
title: OpenAdapt: your agent decides, OpenAdapt enters it and checks it saved
description: Your AI agent decides what to enter. OpenAdapt enters it in the app and checks that it saved.

packageArguments.description: Serve a directory of compiled bundles over MCP (stdio).

packageArguments.name: --bundles
packageArguments.description: Directory of compiled openadapt-flow bundles (one bundle, or a directory whose immediate subdirectories are bundles). This is the operator's own private artifact and is never shipped with the package.

environmentVariables.name: OPENADAPT_BUNDLE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Decryption key for encrypted-at-rest bundles (workflow.json.enc). Omit for plaintext bundles.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.notes: Starts read-only with --bundles: list_workflows and get_run plus the older inspection tools. --mode production adds run_workflow, which takes the caller's request_id and returns done, needs_review, not_sure_if_saved, or did_not_run. --mode attended also adds Reject, Teach, and Escalate; Continue and Skip also need a qualified deployment --config. Without --bundles the server is a synthetic sandbox. See docs/DISTRIBUTION.md.
